CustomField.formula: IF(AND(Amount__c > 0, Amount__c < 1000), "$" + TEXT(Amount__c), IF(AND(Amount__c >= 1000, Amount__c < 10000), "$" + LEFT(TEXT(Amount__c),1) + "," + MID(TEXT(Amount__c),2,3) + "." + RIGHT(TEXT(Amount__c),2), IF(AND(Amount__c >= 10000, Amount__c < 100000), "$" + LEFT(TEXT(Amount__c),2) + "," + MID(TEXT(Amount__c),3,3) + "." + RIGHT(TEXT(Amount__c),2), IF(AND(Amount__c >= 100000, Amount__c < 1000000), "$" + LEFT(TEXT(Amount__c),3) + "," + MID(TEXT(Amount__c),4,3) + "." + RIGHT(TEXT(Amount__c),2), IF(AND(Amount__c >= 1000000, Amount__c < 10000000), "$" + LEFT(TEXT(Amount__c),1) + "," + MID(TEXT(Amount__c),2,3) + "," + MID(TEXT(Amount__c),5,3) + "." + RIGHT(TEXT(Amount__c),2), TEXT(Amount__c))))))
CustomField.inlineHelpText: This is the formula that formats the Amount field. It will not work in templates. Use Amount Formula for Templates field.
CustomField.label: Amount Formula
